name: obsidian-viz-studio
description: Viz Studio: local diagram/chart/canvas/graph generation for Obsidian, exposed to agent chat over the additive MCP bridge on its owner-only Unix socket (viz-studio.sock)

scripts.lint:transport: if [ ! -f src/bridge/uds-listener.ts ]; then echo 'lint:transport FAILED: src/bridge/uds-listener.ts is missing. It is the one file allowed to create the bridge server and listen, on its Unix socket.'; exit 1; fi; if grep -rnE 'createServer\(|\.listen\(' src | grep -v '^src/bridge/uds-listener\.ts:'; then echo 'lint:transport FAILED: createServer( or .listen( outside src/bridge/uds-listener.ts. The Viz Studio bridge serves only its Unix socket, through that helper, and no TCP listener may exist.'; exit 1; else echo 'lint:transport OK'; fi
